title: Ward 4B escape plan
goal: A practitioner can read this escape plan at a glance: Ward 4B escape plan.

rubric.must: A visible YOU ARE HERE marker, legend, and two marked exits are present.
Primary and secondary routes visibly lead from the marker to separate exits.
A reader can visually follow the principal flow or relationship from beginning to end.
Key labels remain legible and attached to the correct visible elements.
Lines and symbols do not visually imply unintended connections.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source, the rubric and the evacuation/iso exemplar, without seeing the engine's own output.

review.evidence: The Ward 4B plan is readable at a glance. A prominent YOU ARE HERE marker in the Nurse Station connects to clearly differentiated green routes leading west and east through the ward corridor to two marked final exits. Room, safety-equipment, assembly-point, stair, and legend labels are legible and visibly associated with the correct elements.

items.evidence: Visible YOU ARE HERE marker, full legend, and two EXIT labels with final-exit symbols are present.
The primary route visibly leads east to Stair East and its exit, while the alternative route leads west to Stair West and its separate exit.
Green directional arrows make both paths from the Nurse Station marker through the Ward Corridor to the exits easy to follow.
Ward, room, stair, exit, equipment, assembly-point, and route-legend labels are legible and attached to their corresponding visible features.
Route branches, door openings, stair enclosures, and safety symbols are visually distinct and do not imply unintended connections.
